timing_note: Diagnostic timers add overhead; not an uninstrumented performance result. Native entries include retries; actual successful mode counts and Python fallbacks are in runner. Other attempt time includes preparation/compilation and unmeasured conversion/commit work. Timers attribute only the selected region.
driver_times_note: All six instrumented state-reset kernel times, including external Python energy at unchanged boundary. First cold; remaining five warm. Never headline latency.
program_selection_note: Region.program_for wall includes cold saved-graph/source reconstruction, AOT preparation/validation and any nested load; cached calls retain selection overhead. Overlaps existing phase timers, not an additive new component or pure source-restore timer. No eager seed-module import added.
arena_note: F/I alias one8byte-per-slot arena; capacity is not live bytes. top includes loaded roots plus retained transient allocations; status2 indicates growth retry. Instrumented, not headline timing.
